subject: ClearWave clinic profile — recording plan & release
messages:
From: Dr. Leah Simon <leah.simon@clearwavemed.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood-inference.com
Date: 2026-07-01T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Quick question: short video case profile?

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the support on the pilot integration — our ops team has been impressed with the latency improvements and clinicians have started referencing the feature in daily huddles. Marketing asked if ClearWave could do a short (2–3 minute) clinic profile / practitioner story to highlight operational impact.

We’d be open to a simple on-camera interview with our ED and a couple of B-roll shots at the clinic. Do you run these in-house or do you work with a vendor? Rough timeline: looking to film the week of July 12 if that works. Happy to share a release form if you have one.

Best,
Leah
Dr. Leah Simon
Chief Medical Officer | ClearWave Medical
leah.simon@clearwavemed.com
(415) 555-0142

From: aditya_rao@redwood-inference.com
To: Dr. Leah Simon <leah.simon@clearwavemed.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com, monica_patel@redwood-inference.com
Date: 2026-07-01T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question: short video case profile?

Hi Leah — really glad to hear the team is getting value. We’d love to collaborate on a clinic profile. We run the creative and production in-house for shorter shoots, and we can also engage our preferred vendor if you’d like a larger crew.

High-level options:
- In-house lightweight shoot (1 cam + sound) — 2–3 hours on site, Redwood editor handles cut (recommended for short profile)
- Vendor full crew — full B-roll day, multicam, higher polish, 1 day

Logistics I need from you to firm up dates: preferred shoot day(s), clinic start time, and whether staff need to sign releases (we can provide forms). We usually ask for 60–90 minutes with the on-camera clinician and 30–45 minutes for B-roll.

I’m cc’ing Marissa (customer storytelling) and Monica (logistics) to coordinate schedule and release paperwork. We can target July 13 or 14 — does that align with your crew?

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Customer Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood-inference.com

From: aditya_rao@redwood-inference.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com, karthik_iyer@redwood-inference.com, monica_patel@redwood-inference.com
Date: 2026-07-01T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: ClearWave shoot — proposed slate and legal checklist

Team — quick internal plan so we’re aligned before I send the final schedule to Leah: 

Overview
- Customer: ClearWave Medical (Clinic: Sunset Community Clinic)
- Primary talent: Dr. Leah Simon (ED), optional nurse for b-roll/interview clip
- Target length: 2–3 minute clinic profile focused on operational improvements from Redwood inference routing

Proposed shoot day/process (lightweight in-house option):
- Call time: 08:30 local (check-in + brief with clinician)
- On-camera interview: 09:00–10:00 (single handheld camera, lav mic)
- B-roll: 10:15–11:00 (patient flow, staff at terminals, Whiteboard huddle)
- Wrap: 11:15

Script/talking points (short bullets for Leah):
- Short intro: name, role, clinic scope (15–20s)
- The problem before Redwood (manual routing, delays)
- What changed: specific example (one metric if possible: average triage time reduction)
- Clinician impact: day-to-day difference, patient experience
- Quick close: why you’d recommend (10–15s)

Crew + equipment
- 1 shooter (in-house) + 1 producer (Marissa)
- Camera: Sony a7S III or equivalent, lav and boom, small LED panel

Legal / release checklist
- Standard participant release for clinician + staff (we’ll provide PDF)
- Location release from clinic admin (signed)
- HIPAA note: do not film identifiable patient PHI; if a patient appears, obtain signed release — prefer staged B-roll with consenting volunteers

Action items
- Monica: draft the shoot schedule Excel (I’ll attach to outbound email)
- Marissa: I’ll send draft talking points to Leah for edits; you’ll produce on shoot day
- Karthik: check with legal about our typical clinic-specific HIPAA language and confirm redlines we should expect

If no major flags, I’ll send the plan + release to Leah this afternoon.

Thanks,
Aditya

From: aditya_rao@redwood-inference.com
To: Dr. Leah Simon <leah.simon@clearwavemed.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood-inference.com, marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com
Date: 2026-07-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ClearWave clinic profile — Recording plan & release

Hi Leah — attached is a concise shoot schedule and our standard participant release. Also linking a short draft of the talking points in case you want tweaks: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cClearWaveShootDraft (doc: Draft_TalkingPoints_Leah.md).

Key items:
- Proposed shoot date: Tuesday, July 13 — call time 08:30, expect ~2.5 hours on site
- On-camera interview ~30 minutes; we’ll keep to the bullets and not ask for long scripted responses
- Attached: ClearWave_Release_Scanned.pdf (please sign and return), clearwave_shoot_schedule_v1.xlsx (call times and crew contacts)

Legal note: we’ve flagged HIPAA-safe guidance in the release. If clinic prefers to use their own counsel redline, we can accept reasonable edits but will need final sign-off by July 9 to lock the schedule.

Minor request: if you can confirm a single metric or short anecdote (e.g., average triage time improvement) that we can reference, we’ll try to include a small graphic in the cut.

Thanks again — excited to showcase the work.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior Customer Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachments: ClearWave_Release_Scanned.pdf (PDF), clearwave_shoot_schedule_v1.xlsx (Excel)

A couple of small edits to the talking points (see inline): prefer to reference "average triage turnaround" instead of triage time, and change the line about "manual routing" to "manual phone handoffs" for clarity.

I’m attaching the signed release: [Attachment: ClearWave_Release_Scanned.pdf (signed)]. Ops will coordinate a staff volunteer for staged patient B-roll. We also shared the HubSpot deal record: HS-98324 if you want to sync notes.

Looking forward to it—see you on the 13th.

Best,
Leah
